Multi-target build orchestrator.
Sourcesrc/shared\scripts\build\build-targets.mjs
UX surfaceBoot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

BUILD_WORKERS

Concurrent vite-build pool width. Each child peaks around 1.5–2.5GB (rolldown graph + terser + compression plugin), so the cap is RAM- derived: ~4GiB per build against total memory, bounded by cores. LK_BUILD_WORKERS overrides for hosts with different budgets.

buildTier

Runs vite build for one tier. Derived tiers (babelFrom) are skipped here — they lower an already-emitted bundle in the post-pass below. first marks the owner build: it alone wipes dist/ (emptyOutDir) and copies the public dir, so it must run BEFORE the parallel wave starts.

  • @param {object} t ES_TARGETS entry
  • @param {number} i index in buildList (banner display only)
  • @param {boolean} first whether this build owns dist/ initialization
  • @returns {Promise} resolves on child exit 0

tierCursor

Bounded drain over the remaining tiers: BUILD_WORKERS workers pull from the shared index until exhausted. Each vite child writes only its own dist/v// tree (LK_EMPTY_OUTDIR=0), so concurrent children can never touch each other's output. Iterative worker-drain — the tasks are already materialized, no self-similar traversal here.

compiledCssSheet

Lazily-cached sass compilation of the global sheet — the input file and options are identical for every tier call, so the (~1-2s) compile runs once per build instead of once per emitCss() call (up to 26 times). Only the per-tier lightningcss targets differ downstream.
